title: The Fallen Survey Line
description: Fractured limestone drums, a fallen moulding and weathered ashlar in an eight-metre scatter.

review.notes: Round 3 (final, rebuilt). Fixed: the pepper speckle is gone, the cavity is gone, and the pieces have some ground contact. Not fixed or new: (1) the flutes are now deep square-cut slots with flat teeth, so the drums read as gear wheels or cogs (hero.jpg). (2) The large disc is a featureless smooth white plate or egg with a bumpy rim (closeup.jpg); it reads as neither a drum nor a capital. (3) There is still no fall line of one toppled column and no capital or cornice fragment with a readable profile (round-1 points 2 and 4). (4) The angular fragments are clean, similar prisms. Fix: shallow concave flutes with fillets matching column_white_a, drums laid out in sequence along a fall line, a profiled capital fragment, and break faces and partial burial.
